'''2009 Bespin Regionals Jake Nelson DS Coruscant: ISB Central Office''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jake Nelson]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Name on sheet:''' Jake N
* '''Username:''' Jeff Bradley
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
